purpose: Compose the canonical apparel Catalog, 18 ownership-safe compatibility projections, exact channel Listing, Order/Payment/Fulfillment/Inventory flow, immediate replay proof, and canonical commerce-v2 lakehouse reconciliation.
environment_policy: local, demo, or disposable test tenant only
flow: fail closed unless lakehousectl exposes all required v2 commands
run Catalog to ACTIVE for one Style/SPU and six apparel SKU
create or replay 18 PENDING Mall/ERP/WMS identity projection snapshots
require all 23 commerce-v2 business commands to replay as immutable duplicates
run config-check, contract-test, apply-models, and all lakehouse tests
reconcile canonical Catalog by catalog child run_id
reconcile canonical commerce-v2 by commerce child run_id
replay_contract: same parent run_id reuses Catalog operation results, makes projection changed_count zero, and retains duplicate immutable results for all commerce-v2 commands
cleanup: none; retain every child ledger and the parent evidence ledger outside the Skill
